title: When no problem remains to solve, effort loses the meaning it drew from meeting needs, leaving only short-term stimulation
body:
- Complete material comfort with no challenges leaves a person without the framework for understanding what to contribute.
- The absence of friction or unmet needs eliminates the call to action that gives human effort its purpose.
- People then default to short-term stimulation rather than pursuing meaningful goals.
conversion: the absence of problems, which should give peace, instead produces short-term stimulation seeking in place of meaningful effort
